entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • RID-specific tool packaging should make the top-level pointer package use the `any` TFM for improved compatibility #55106
  • Installation & Packaging (Linux/RHEL 9) #55100
  • RuntimeProcessLauncherTests.RelaunchOnCrash: IOException file used by another process #55098
  • Rename runner-agnostic `SDKCustomXUnit*` Helix infrastructure to a runner-neutral name #55094
  • [Unstable][Linux/Mac] There is an error "Cannot access a disposed object." when press "Ctrl + C" to shut down the application #55096

Closed

  • `dotnet tool install` doesn't log bad version #54796
  • Migrate test infrastructure from xUnit v2 to xUnit v3 #52914
  • [Loc]Strings are over translated on .net5 SDK installation completion dialog for DE/SC/TK. #12394
    Backlog
